Open the deck [in its own tab](../../slides/eu-frames-short.html){target="_blank"} for the full screen, the speaker view and the keyboard controls: `[` and `]` jump between the two halves, and `g` opens a jump bar that finds a slide by its title. The deck has no optional runs, so every slide is shown.
